headline: Arborist Committee plans December tree-measuring visit

meeting.summary: The Arborist Committee approved August minutes, planned a December tree-measuring visit, and set its next meeting for November 13, 2024.
meeting.recap: No public testimony was received, and there were no emails or calls.[[0:01:18]] The committee approved the minutes of its August 14 meeting by a unanimous show of hands.[[0:01:59]] Arbor Day is on November 2, and members are invited to attend if they can.[[0:02:31]] The chair plans a December site visit so members can learn how to measure exceptional trees.[[0:03:54]] The committee may store exceptional tree data in Tree Plotter, an app the County already pays for, at no added cost.[[0:04:31]] The chair will try to hold the site visit in the first week or so of December.[[0:06:34]] A speaker said the Sunshine Law means the committee's working group (TIG) should give only a final presentation at meetings, not updates.[[0:11:59]] A group called Maui Green and Beautiful will take over the citizen forestry program and train residents to measure trees.[[0:13:39]] The next meeting is set for November 13, 2024, at 1:30 p.m.[[0:14:38]] Members confirmed the December meeting will be held in person.[[0:15:20]]
decided: The committee approved the August 14 minutes as presented, with everyone in favor.
A motion to adjourn was made and seconded, and the meeting ended.
meeting.next: The chair will follow up with the site contact to set the December visit date and tell members. The chair will send login credentials for Tree Plotter once its use is confirmed. The chair will send the tree assessment form as a Word document to all members.
